name: Armored Guardian — firing its shroud ability does not overflow the stack
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. Same root cause as the Akroma recipe: _isProtectedFromSource called Battlefield.getAllFinalStates() mid-evaluation for a fired-ability pseudo-perm and recursed forever. Armored Guardian fires '{1}{U}{U}: This creature gains shroud until end of turn' and must gain Shroud and stay 2/5.

call: This creature gains shroud until end of turn.
{1}{U}{U}: This creature gains shroud until end of turn.
